```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
```

```{r Daten einlesen}
el <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luluhackt/Voracts_SNA/refs/heads/main/edgelist_voracts.csv", header = T, as.is = T, sep = ",")
nl <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luluhackt/Opener_SNA/refs/heads/main/nodelist_opener.csv", header = T, as.is = T, sep = ",")
el <- el%>%
  mutate(
    from = match(from, nl$id),
    to   = match(to,   nl$id)
  )
s <- tbl_graph(nodes = nl, edges = el, directed = TRUE)
s
```

```{r Visualisierung}
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)
ggraph(s, layout = "graphopt") +
  geom_edge_link(color = "gray50", edge_width = 0.5) +
  geom_node_point(size = 2, color = "midnightblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, size = 3, color = "black") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


```{r}
g <- s %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  mutate(
    degree_total = centrality_degree()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(degree_total))
g
  
```
